verdict.rationale: cubic provides a PR diff view that can hide test files and shows group explanations beside the diff. It automatically reviews new pull requests and comments on bugs, and the `cubic review` CLI checks local changes before push. Deeper checks come from Ultrareview, custom agents and cross-repo reviews. missing for 10: evidence of running deterministic CI/test checks or merge-blocking status checks (the 'checks' here are AI reviews), and independent hands-on corroboration that the reviews reliably catch problems.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Focus on implementation changes by hiding test files from the PR diff and file tree.
the group description stays beside the diff as you scroll, so you can read the code and its explanation together
Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
Run a review before you push to catch issues while you're working.... review your uncommitted changes: `cubic review`
Ultrareview runs a longer review using cubic's most capable review models, which is useful for risky migrations, security-sensitive changes, or complex refactors.
Link related repositories so reviews can check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work.
